cover.title:
单项有效的 RAG 技术
叠在一起，收益缩水
cover.dek: 三项检索技术各自有效，叠在一起预测能涨 47%，实测只涨了 17%。记忆和检索是今天论文热度榜的主线，做 RAG 的人值得先看这篇。
cover.title_en:
Each RAG technique helps alone
Stack three and the gain shrinks
cover.dek_en: Three retrieval techniques that each work on their own were predicted to add 47% when combined. Measured gain: 17%. Memory and retrieval lead today's paper charts, so anyone building RAG should start here.
